correctness.rationale: The order-six polynomial H(x) has exactly one zero \(x_*\in(1/16,76/1215)\), as its derivative has strictly positive rational Bernstein coefficients. Independent polynomial identities give all-index positive order-eight and order-seven recurrences on adjacent rational intervals, with exact Bernstein positivity certificates for the requisite seeds and coefficients; an explicit characteristic-root comparison proves the remaining positive range and the infinitely oscillatory high-parameter range. The signed-mass identity is algebraically exact, with absolute convergence. The included standard-library checker reproduces the critical rational certificates and recurrences; the mathematical proof supplies the induction and infinite root-dominance argument.

value.rationale: A complete exact classification of a natural invariant in the current BDF3 fading-memory stability analysis is achieved: the causal scalar Green sequence has norm-one convolution response exactly for \(\mu\le\mu_*\), with sharp threshold 0.831264155... instead of the published sufficient bound 1099/1536 (~0.715494792). This extends the certified nonamplifying spectral range by ~16.18%, shows an order-six first sign loss, and distinguishes eventual complex-root oscillation from finite-index negativity. The object and invariant are prescribed by the motivating paper rather than artificially chosen.
